VERDICT: RESTRUCTURE

WHY
- B-20 stress test (qualification): GDS 39.9% and TDS 45.4% exceed the 39%/44% limits at the 6.19% qualifying rate (MortgageLoanOps, Decision Ladder core).
- Cash to close (closing): $19,875 shortfall ($239,875 needed vs $220,000 saved) (Cash to Close, Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite).
- Affordability (affordability): Maximum supported price $1,064,600 vs $1,100,000 contract price; $35,400 gap (Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite, Canada Housing Affordability Index 1980-2026).
- Document check (documents): Documented income $99,000 covers only 53.5% of stated $185,000; 1 discrepancy (Decision Ladder core, Doc Quest).
- Pre-underwriting readiness (readiness): Score 20/100 with 5 flags (2 high: GDS/TDS exceedance; 3 medium: missing employment letter, NOA, down payment statement) (Loan File Pre-Underwriting Check, Quiet Charges, Shoebox).

PATH TO YES
1. Lower the price to $1,067,000.
2. Raise the down payment to $255,500 (+$35,500).

CONDITIONS & RISKS
- Identity/watch-list screening not performed; manual verification required (MortgageLoanOps).
- Only B-lenders fit; expect higher rates/fees — disclose to client (MortgageLoanOps).
- Oakville semi benchmark $1,185,000; price -7.2% vs benchmark, but benchmarks are indicative, not an appraisal (Benchmark Home Value).
- Renewal outlook: +1.0% rate scenario drives payment +10.5% to ~$4,727/month (30.7% of income) in 5 years (Renewal Shock Radar).
- APR disclosure 4.190% ($174,681 over 5-year term) must be delivered ≥2 business days before signing (MortgageLoanOps, Decision Ladder core).

NEXT ACTIONS FOR THE BROKER
1. Verify client identity and run watch-list checks manually; document the result.
2. Collect missing documents: employment letter, NOA, down payment statement; reconcile the documented income ($99,000) vs stated income ($185,000) gap.
3. Present the two restructuring options (price reduction to $1,067,000 or down payment increase to $255,500) and confirm client capacity.
4. Disclose B-lender terms, fees, and the APR 4.190% cost of borrowing ($174,681) per regulatory timelines.
5. Advise on renewal risk: payment could rise to ~$4,727/month at renewal; confirm affordability buffer.
